title: Chapter 868
paragraphs: Chapter 868
216th Episode. The First Golden Ship (4)

There were a total of five fissures formed near the entire capital of the Empire. One large fissure and four medium to small scale fissures, if they were identified in advance, those with the ability to eliminate the fissures would have been dispatched.
Moreover, what about the number of demons emerging from the fissures?

Already over a thousand had come out of the smallest fissure that opened first. Castles and fortresses from the Demon Realm were formed throughout the mountain range, and nearly a dozen ships rose into the sky.

No matter how formidable the defense of the capital was, it could not avoid damage from such an unexpected attack. Even if the superhumans including Dante and the knights of the Empire were to sortie immediately, it was impossible to suppress them without any damage.
However, the technology of the Barmel Alliance was making the impossible possible.
"Hahahahaha!"
Kwaul burst out into a hearty laugh. Today was the happiest day of his life as an engineer. Luet and Kasimir sighed with relief, hearing his laughter over the communication device.
"I need to focus on the battle now, so I'll end the communication here. I'll report back when the situation is over!"
{Understood, Dr. Kwaul. But just in case, I will keep the Archduke and Mot on standby.}
"Okay, Steward Luet! If something difficult to handle appears, I'll contact you again. It shouldn't happen, but hahaha!"
Already, more than 90% of the demons that came out of the first fissure had disappeared without a trace with just one shot from the cannon of the Golden Ship.
The five summoned fortresses were smashed before they could show anything, and only one or two ships from the Demon Realm were left.
It wasn't even at maximum output. Kwaul was squinting his eyes and targeting the next fissures.
"...Is this really the destructive power that can be obtained purely by technology without the power of superh
umans?"
Dante didn't even have time to get angry about the surprise attack.
At first, he was worried about the nightmare of Diffus and what to do if the people were slaughtered again, but seeing the power of the Golden Ship, he was simply speechless.
"That's right, Golden Emperor!"
[It's not just pure technology, Dr. Kwaul. Have you forgotten that my authority and my brother's energy are enhancing the storm balloon?]
"In a broader sense, isn't that also within the realm of technology, Lord Phaitel!"
[Well, that's true. Look there, it looks like another fissure is about to open. We need to give them a beating soon.]
"Raise the output! This time it's 60%!"
"Yes!"
The crew of the Rainbow Birds responded to Kwaul's command.
Currently, the only person on the ship worthy of being called a superhuman was Dante. The rest were all non-combat personnel, and Dante did not even add his own energy to the power.
As Jin and the Barmel Alliance had longed for, a device that could exert transcendental power with 'ordinary people' had finally been completed.
Although Kwaul was in charge as the captain, similar knowledge was not essential for operating the ship.
Rooaaar…!
The power of the Golden Ship was making a loud and heavy noise. Facing the noise that sounded like a gigantic beast roaring, Kwaul and the crew felt a shiver run down their spines.
And those who were facing that sound, the demons of the Demon Realm that had just been summoned to the ground, had to be filled with fear.
"Wha... what on earth. Lord Grain, didn't the demons of the 17th castle get wiped out in a single attack from that ship...? It has also been confirmed that Lord Monte has been killed."

Unable to respond to a demon soldier's words, Grain alternately stared at the Golden Ship and the area where the bombardment had fallen. Grain was one of the All-People Generals of the Demon Realm, and was the person in charge of the spearhead role in this surprise disruption operation.
The same was true of Monte, who had just died. More All-People Generals and forces were scheduled to be summoned from the remaining small and medium fissures.
Zuuuaaak!
The thunderstorm surrounding the Golden Ship was distorting the nearby space. Grain was reminded of the terrible old legends that were passed on to the Demon Realm from the Golden Ship.
'Fortresses in the sky operated by the Ming royal family... Does such a thing exist on the ground too?'
Grain had not directly experienced that time. However, one thing was clear, whether that monster-like ship was better than the air fortress or not.
It was the fact that the All-People Generals and their troops did not have the power to suppress that ship.
"Scatter... scatter!"
"Excuse me?"
"I said all forces scatter! The disruption mission has failed, we must survive somehow until Beacon Lord is summoned."
He couldn't utter the word 'Hurry!'

All of a sudden, everything in front of him became bright. The second bombardment from the Golden Ship thus wiped out Grain and about two thousand demons. Most of them couldn't even realize the moment they died. After the feeling of a sudden flash of light passed, it was over.

"...I can see why Jin so desperately wanted the Golden Ship. I'm just relieved that the ones who possess this technology are Jin and the Barmel Alliance. If technology advances further, there might come a day when knights like us are no longer needed."
Dante shuddered at the thought of what would have happened if Gipul or Kinzelo, or the enemy race or the Demon Realm, had the Golden Ship.

"Hehe, Sword Emperor. Even if this Golden Ship begins to be mass-produced, superhumans like you are absolutely necessary. After all, there are limits to suppressing such madmen with just such a thing. It might be a bit challenging to deal with those coming out of the Great Fissure with just the power of the Golden Ship. Please step up then, Sword Emperor."
The third rift that opened also ended with one shot of the ship cannon.

If the demons were merely ordinary beings dragged into an unwanted war, it would have been uncomfortable. Every time a bombardment was made, thousands, and then thousands more, lives were disappearing.

But there were no such people among the demons. From the start, Ameris had said while analyzing the fissures, that the summoning magic of Jito was possible thanks to his tremendous authority, but the intense desire of the summoned was also necessary.
Only the demons, captivated by the desire to plunge all humanity of the human world into suffering and swallow up the ground, could use that summoning circle.
Now wasn't the time to show mercy even to those people. It was time to sweep away those who threatened the peace of the Barmel Alliance, the lives of the human world, without discrimination.
"Of course."
Now the remaining rifts were two of medium size and one large one.
Only 5 minutes had passed since the start of the battle. The surviving demons were gritting their teeth as they looked up at the Golden Ship.
No matter how strong that ship is, once Beacon Lord is summoned, it will be unavoidable...

The demons harbored such expectations. The moment Beacon is summoned from the Great Fissure, the tide of the battle will instantly flip, and the entire imperial capital will be filled with human cries, sighs, and screams.
The third and fourth medium-sized fissures were completed at the same time.
They had confirmed how the previous demons had disappeared just before being summoned, so they prepared to disperse as soon as they were summoned.
'The gun is ultimately one. No matter which side gets attacked first, the remaining side will disperse and try to infiltrate...!'
The newly summoned All-People Generals made such a judgment. By sacrificing one side and dispersing, if they hold out for just a little bit, they will be able to push back with the support of Beacon.
"Output at 100%, but divide it to simultaneously attack the two fissures."
However, as soon as Kwaul's command dropped, the Golden Ship's cannons split into two.
"Ah, they're crazy!"
"Why are they splitting up!? Shoot that side, that side!"
The divided cannons were each accurately targeting the newly formed fissures.
"It's a bit regrettable to use 100% output against non-superhuman opponents, but farewell!"

As soon as Kwaul pressed the button, the two divided cannons spewed out a furious bombardment. It was already sufficiently confirmed that the rifts of the All-People Generals could be eliminated with just 50% output.
"And so, two more Universal Generals and their elite forces disappeared. The castles and fortresses, and the fleets that were summoned in groups, were no different.
It was a complete victory.

At this point, the hearts of the remnants who were only looking at the Beacon could not help but waver. Can we really do something about that if Beacon comes out? Such anxiety pierced the inner hearts of the remnants like an awl.
Dante was also thinking the same.
"...Do I really need to step in? It seems that a counterattack would be possible for the demons only if a superhuman of at least my level comes out."
"That's what I'm saying. These guys from the True Demon World, they're not as big a deal as I thought."
"It seems appropriate to say that the Golden Ship is excessively destructive."
Finally, Beacon and his troops came out of the Great Rift. Of course, the scale of the troops was in a different dimension compared to what had been summoned so far.
With at least an estimated force of over 10,000, about a hundred ships, and one demon that Dante carefully observed.
As soon as he appeared, Beacon spread magic around him, showcasing his power.
"I am Beacon Raudio, the general of the True Demon World. I have come to the surface to deliver the command of Lord Zito, so humans, listen with solemn hearts."
"What is he babbling about, he seems to be a friend who doesn't understand the situation. Guys, show him what full output looks like."
The cannon, combined again into one, poured out a massive strike that seemed to split the sky in half. The world vibrated for a moment, and the magic Beacon spread formed a barrier.
The ship's cannon couldn't penetrate his barrier. Beacon became the first demon to withstand the Golden Ship's bombardment.
"Oh, it's definitely Beacon..."
"Lord Beacon! Please take revenge for us!"
Beacon stood tall on the wall of his castle, which was summoned in a similar way to the first time.
But he was disconcerted. Although he hadn't got a scratch thanks to the barrier, he felt that he would be helpless if such attacks continued.
'...There was nothing like this among the ships of the human world that I was informed of before the invasion. What is this? It can't possibly fire another cannon like this, can it?'
But the Golden Ship's output was intact. There was no way the authority of Thunder God Gram and Storm God Paytel would run out after a few bombardments.
"Well, let's fire another shot and send him back to hell quickly. It seems like today, Black Emperor, you can just watch and go back."
Quaul grinned and ordered to raise the output again.

In the end, Beacon, who had all the expectations of all the demons summoned to the Empire, left a desperate cry at the fourth bombardment and was annihilated. Along with it, all the cities of the demon world that were summoned became ruins.
And Jin, watching the advent festival of the Holy Kingdom, received all the situations and smiled contentedly.
"I was worried that I might have to move before I met Ayulra, but it seems that both Hufester and the Empire have been neatly sorted out."
